rationale: With only 13 minutes to close and price sitting at 98.1% of today's range near the session high ($213.73), the risk/reward for a long is poor — minimal upside before the day's high acts as resistance and forced liquidation at close creates execution risk. A short against the intraday uptrend (price has rallied from $201 low, above 9-EMA at $213.04) is equally unattractive given the strong momentum in the last several candles. The account is already down on the day and the remaining loss budget doesn't justify a low-conviction late-session trade with compressed time.
